svg.title: DataPilot
svg.desc: DataPilot: AI-powered data analysis, web scraping and machine learning in one workspace. Ask your data questions in plain English. AI web scraper with pagination & search mode. No-code ML trainer with auto hyperparameter tuning. Charts, reports and exportable Python code. Built with FastAPI, Streamlit, scikit-learn, Gemini.
